==Tournament information==
The LAN will host official tournaments in the following modes:
* '''1on1'''
* '''2on2'''
* '''4on4'''


As we listened to feedback from [[QHLAN2017]], there was an overweight towards 1on1/2on2 and too little 4on4. This was much due to too many group stages, and QHLAN2019 will aim to simplify this. 

Probably we'll be seeing a '''double elimination system with no(or only one) group stage''' before.

This page will be updated when a decision is reached.
